whitepaper.title: Understanding PYRAX
whitepaper.subtitle: A beginner-friendly explanation of what PYRAX is, how it works, and why it matters. No technical jargon required.

whatIs.label: Introduction
whatIs.title: What is PYRAX?
whatIs.p1: PYRAX is a new type of blockchain designed for the AI era. Think of it as a decentralized computer network where anyone with a graphics card (GPU) can participate in securing the network while also providing computing power for artificial intelligence tasks.
whatIs.p2: Unlike traditional blockchains that only process financial transactions, PYRAX creates a marketplace where AI developers can rent computing power from GPU owners around the world. This makes AI more accessible and affordable for everyone.
whatIs.point1: A blockchain built specifically for AI computing
whatIs.point2: GPU miners earn rewards for securing the network AND running AI jobs
whatIs.point3: Supports smart contracts compatible with Ethereum
whatIs.point4: Can process over 500,000 transactions per second

problem.label: The Challenge
problem.title: Why Do We Need PYRAX?
problem.intro: The current landscape has several problems that PYRAX aims to solve:

issue1.title: AI Computing is Expensive
issue1.desc: Training and running AI models requires expensive cloud services from big tech companies. Small developers and researchers are priced out.

issue2.title: Centralized Control
issue2.desc: A few large companies control most AI computing resources, creating bottlenecks and single points of failure.

issue3.title: Wasted GPU Power
issue3.desc: Millions of powerful gaming GPUs sit idle when not gaming. This computing power could be put to productive use.

issue4.title: Limited Blockchain Scalability
issue4.desc: Most blockchains are too slow for AI applications, processing only 15-50 transactions per second.

solution.label: The Answer
solution.title: How PYRAX Solves These Problems
solution.intro: PYRAX brings together three innovations to create a faster, more inclusive blockchain ecosystem:

benefit1.title: TriStream Consensus
benefit1.desc: Three parallel mining streams work together - ASIC miners, GPU miners, and validators - providing unprecedented security and decentralization.

benefit2.title: Dual-Purpose Mining
benefit2.desc: GPU miners don't just secure the network - they can also earn extra rewards by running AI compute jobs when their hardware is available.

benefit3.title: Layer 2 Scaling
benefit3.desc: Built-in ZK-Rollup support enables 500,000+ transactions per second, making PYRAX fast enough for any application.

howItWorks.label: The Technology
howItWorks.title: How Does PYRAX Work?
howItWorks.intro: PYRAX uses a unique three-layer architecture that separates concerns for maximum efficiency:

tristream.title: TriStream Consensus
tristream.desc: Instead of relying on a single type of miner, PYRAX uses three parallel streams that work together:

streamA.name: Stream A (ASIC)
streamA.desc: High-speed transaction processing using specialized mining hardware. Produces blocks every 10 seconds.

streamB.name: Stream B (GPU)
streamB.desc: GPU mining that also enables AI compute. Uses the KAWPOW algorithm to stay ASIC-resistant.

streamC.name: Stream C (Validators)
streamC.desc: Proof of stake validators provide ZK-STARK finality proofs, making transactions irreversible.

l3.title: ZK-Rollups
l3.desc: The top layer handles high-volume applications like AI, DeFi, and gaming with 500,000+ TPS.

l2.title: EVM Sidechain
l2.desc: A fully Ethereum-compatible layer for smart contracts. Deploy Solidity code seamlessly.

l1.title: TriStream DAG
l1.desc: The foundation layer using GHOSTDAG ordering to unify all three mining streams into one secure ledger.

mining.label: Participation
mining.title: Mining & Earning PYRAX
mining.intro: There are multiple ways to participate in the PYRAX network and earn rewards:

way1.title: ASIC Mining (Stream A)
way1.desc: Use BLAKE3 ASIC miners for high-speed block production. Best for dedicated mining operations.

way2.title: GPU Mining (Stream B)
way2.desc: Mine using your graphics card with KAWPOW algorithm. Can also run AI jobs for extra income.

way3.title: Staking (Stream C)
way3.desc: Stake 100,000 PYRAX to become a validator and earn rewards for providing finality proofs.

ai.label: AI Marketplace
ai.title: The AI Compute Platform
ai.intro: PYRAX includes a built-in marketplace where AI developers can rent GPU power from miners around the world:

foundry.title: Foundry - Model Registry
foundry.desc: A place to register, version, and discover AI models.

crucible.desc: Submit AI jobs and have them executed by GPU providers.

conclusion.text: PYRAX represents a new paradigm where blockchain technology meets artificial intelligence. By enabling GPU miners to earn from both network security and AI compute, we're creating a more decentralized and accessible AI infrastructure for everyone.

technicalWhitepaper.title: PYRAX Technical Whitepaper
technicalWhitepaper.subtitle: Complete technical specification of the PYRAX TriStream DAG blockchain, consensus mechanisms, and AI compute infrastructure.

abstract.label: Section 1
abstract.title: Abstract
abstract.p1: PYRAX is a TriStream DAG Layer 1 blockchain implementing three parallel consensus streams unified via GHOSTDAG ordering. The protocol combines BLAKE3 Proof-of-Work for ASIC mining, KAWPOW Proof-of-Work for GPU mining, and ZK-STARK Proof-of-Stake for cryptographic finality.
abstract.p2: This document specifies the complete technical architecture including consensus mechanisms, block structure, cryptographic primitives, smart contract execution environments, and the decentralized AI compute marketplace protocol.

architecture.label: Section 2
architecture.title: System Architecture
architecture.intro: PYRAX implements a three-layer architecture designed for scalability, security, and AI compute integration.

l3.title: ZK-Rollups
l3.desc: Application-specific rollups for AI compute, DeFi, and gaming with validity proofs posted to L1.

l2.title: EVM Sidechain
l2.desc: Full Ethereum Virtual Machine compatibility with Solidity 0.8.x and Rust/WASM contract support.

l1.title: TriStream DAG
l1.desc: Base layer with three parallel mining streams unified by GHOSTDAG consensus ordering.

consensus.label: Section 3
consensus.title: TriStream Consensus Mechanism
consensus.intro: The TriStream consensus employs three parallel block production streams, each optimized for different hardware and use cases.

streamA.desc: High-throughput UTXO transaction processing optimized for specialized mining hardware.

streamB.desc: KAWPOW-based mining enabling dual-purpose GPU utilization for both mining and AI compute jobs.

streamC.desc: ZK-STARK finality checkpoints providing cryptographic proof of transaction irreversibility.

ghostdag.label: Section 4
ghostdag.title: GHOSTDAG Ordering Protocol
ghostdag.intro: GHOSTDAG (Greedy Heaviest-Observed Sub-Tree DAG) orders blocks from all three streams into a single canonical history without orphaning valid blocks.

properties.title: Key Properties
properties.p1: Parallel Block Production: All streams produce blocks concurrently without conflicts.
properties.p2: No Orphan Blocks: Valid blocks are never discarded, maximizing miner rewards.
properties.p3: Hardware Diversity: Supports ASIC, GPU, and validator participation simultaneously.
properties.p4: Fast Finality: Stream C ZK proofs provide irreversible transaction finality.

evm.title: EVM Execution Environment
evm.desc: Full Ethereum Virtual Machine compatibility enabling seamless migration of existing dApps.

wasm.title: WASM Execution Environment
wasm.desc: High-performance Rust/WASM contracts with cross-VM interoperability.

ai.label: Section 8
ai.title: AI Compute Platform Protocol
ai.intro: The AI platform implements a decentralized job marketplace with on-chain settlement and verification.
